title: rollouts: unify canary/AB/shadow flows and add automated rollback policies
author: Olivia Chen
description: Motivation: our existing rollout primitives (canary, A/B, and shadow) lived in separate controllers which made cross-cutting policies (auto-rollback, global traffic routing, and observability) error-prone and duplicate-heavy. This PR consolidates the controllers into a single UnifiedRolloutManager, adds first-class A/B weight routing, consistent shadow traffic handling, and a pluggable automated rollback policy engine that monitors rollout metrics and triggers safe rollbacks on regressions. Design: unified state machine for rollout phases, reconciliation loop that supports partial traffic shifts, heterogeneous model variants, and policy hooks for rollback decisions. Implementation: new controller at rollouts/manager.py, a lightweight shadow router in infra/request_router.py, AB weight APIs in api/v1/rollouts.proto + console UI components, and a rollback policy engine in rollouts/policy_engine.py with YAML-configurable thresholds. Tests and docs included. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind rollout.unified_v1; staged deploy to dedicated clusters, run canary e2e for 48h, then enable on hosted with 0.5% of traffic then ramp. See linked Linear tickets for evaluation criteria.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) unify controller skeleton and state machine; 2) add AB weight routing + shadow router; 3) rollback policy engine, tests, and docs; includes small console UI changes and proto updates.
